fill.about: Over 100 years ago William Croghan, a hand engraver and jeweler opened his store in an 18th century Charleston single house on King St. Croghan's Jewel Box is a treasure trove of the most exciting and unique inventory of jewelry. From Wedding Services, Estate and Antique finds to gifts for every occasion.
